motive.zhHans: 他杀死 Daisaku Katsumoto，是因为对方刊登的一篇假报道害得报道中的那位女演员自杀。Keisuke 厌恶 Katsumoto 对受害者的漠视，也厌恶社长只是为了销量才这么做、玷污了他全心投入的公司。他也无法忍受那位女演员——他的老同学——可能至死都以为是他故意把照片放进那篇假报道。当社长威胁说若不撤诉就再写一篇误导性报道时，他在盛怒之下杀了他。
motive.en: He killed Daisaku Katsumoto because he had published a false article that lead to the suicide of the actress it concerned. Keisuke was disgusted at Katsumoto's disregard for the victim, and that the president only did so for sales, disgracing the company he was passionately working for. He also couldn't bear the thought that the actress, an old classmate of his, could have died believing that he intentionally put the picture in the false article. He, in a fit of rage, killed the president when he threatened to make another misleading article if the lawsuit wasn't dropped.

resolution.zhHans: 凶手是 Keisuke Ogino。他往自己的啤酒里撒了一些从口袋里取出的净化盐，使啤酒在 7 分钟的时限过去很久之后仍不断起泡。因此，他篡改了不在场证明的时间；证据就在他的夹克口袋里。由于他必须当场伪造不在场证明，他从葬礼的袋子里拿走了那袋盐，事后也没有把它处理掉。他杀死 Daisaku Katsumoto，是因为后者发表了一篇虚假报道，导致报道涉及的那位女演员自杀。Keisuke 厌恶 Katsumoto 对受害者的漠视，也厌恶社长只为销量这么做、玷污了他全心效力的公司。他也无法忍受想到，那位女演员——他的老同学——临死时还以为是他故意把那张照片放进假报道里的。他在盛怒之下杀死了社长，因为社长威胁说如果不起诉就再写一篇误导性的报道。
resolution.en: The culprit is Keisuke Ogino. He sprinkle some purification salt from his pocket into his beer, causing it to froth long after the 7 minute limit. Therefore, he manipulated the time of his alibi; the evidence lay within his jacket pocket. Since he had to fabricate the alibi on the spot, he took the salt bag from the funeral's bag, which he didn't dispose of. He killed Daisaku Katsumoto because he had published a false article that lead to the suicide of the actress it concerned. Keisuke was disgusted at Katsumoto's disregard for the victim, and that the president only did so for sales, disgracing the company he was passionately working for. He also couldn't bear the thought that the actress, an old classmate of his, could have died believing that he intentionally put the picture in the false article. He, in a fit of rage, killed the president when he threatened to make another misleading article if the lawsuit wasn't dropped.
